acceptance_scope: Source-only proposal validation; not clean compilation or kernel completion
independent_review_scope: Exact final script and manifest hashes; quote Char, adjacent custom-notation Char and space Char regression checks; no remaining blocking finding
lexical_repairs: Recognize Char literals and official escapes before strings
Consume identifier apostrophes atomically using official identifier ranges
Treat escaped identifiers atomically and support zero-hash raw strings
Recognize only unambiguous spaced standard primed sum/product tokens
Reject custom notation/syntax/infix/prefix/postfix declarations as unreviewed token-table changes
manifest_equality: Exact byte equality with independently reviewed final umbrella source manifest
test_scope: Disposable non-Lean fixtures; no compiler launched
